title: Lenskart Solutions among 4 stocks to hit 52-week highs & surge up to 20% in a month - Fresh Highs | The Economic Times
text:
On Monday, the benchmark Sensex fell 172 points to close at 77,369. Despite the broader market decline, four stocks from the BSE 200 Index touched fresh 52-week highs, marking their strongest price levels in the past year. A 52-week high is generally considered a positive technical indicator, reflecting strong investor interest and improving market sentiment, while also signalling the potential for further upward momentum.

New 52-week high: Rs 673.35| CMP: Rs 659.7. In the last one month stock has gained about 19%.

New 52-week high: Rs 4118| CMP: Rs 4100. In the last one month stock has gained about 11%.

New 52-week high: Rs 1127.15| CMP: Rs 1113. In the last one month stock has gained about 11%.

New 52-week high: Rs 1574.85| CMP: Rs 1552. In the last one month stock has gained about 6%.
